content.user_title: Generate Music with ElevenLabs on RunComfy
content.value_statement: Creating polished music from a short brief can be slow and expensive. This skill guides ElevenLabs Music generation through RunComfy.
actual_capabilities: Generates vocal songs and instrumental tracks with ElevenLabs Music through RunComfy.
Uses structured prompts with style, tempo, instruments, lyrics, and song sections.
Supports output lengths from 5 seconds to 5 minutes.
Supports instrumental-only requests with the force_instrumental option.
Shows CLI patterns for saving generated audio to an output directory.
limitations: Requires the RunComfy CLI, account access, and a valid token.
Uses one prompt field for both style details and lyrics.
Does not create sound effects, text-to-speech, or cloned voices.
Generation cost increases with longer audio duration.

use_cases.title: Create a Video Theme
use_cases.description: Generate a structured theme song that matches a video length, mood, and chorus format.

use_cases.title: Produce Podcast Music
use_cases.description: Create short instrumental intros, outros, or beds with clear length and ending requirements.

use_cases.title: Draft Game Audio Loops
use_cases.description: Generate instrumental background tracks with steady tempo, loop-friendly phrasing, and consistent energy.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Instrumental Track
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a simple background track.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a 30 second instrumental track for a calm study video. Use lo-fi drums, warm piano, and no vocals.

prompt_templates.title: Short Brand Jingle
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a short commercial asset.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 5 second cheerful jingle for a friendly coffee brand. Use marimba, hand claps, and a clean ending.

prompt_templates.title: Structured Vocal Song
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request with song sections and lyrical direction.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a 60 second indie pop song with intro, verse, chorus, bridge, and outro. Use bright guitars and hopeful lyrics.

prompt_templates.title: Multilingual Release Draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 45 second Latin pop draft in Spanish. Keep the same tempo, chorus structure, and lead instruments across future versions.

output_examples.input: A creator asks for a 30 second podcast intro with warm synths and no vocals.
output_examples.output: The assistant prepares a concise RunComfy music request with instrumental settings, duration guidance, and an output directory.

output_examples.input: A team asks for a one minute theme song with verse and chorus sections.
output_examples.output: The assistant turns the brief into a structured music prompt with style, tempo, sections, and clear lyrical guidance.

output_examples.input: A game developer asks for a loop-friendly background track.
output_examples.output: The assistant recommends instrumental generation, steady tempo, consistent groove, and a short draft before final rendering.

best_practices: Start with a short draft before generating a long final track.
Put genre, mood, tempo, instruments, and vocal style before lyrics.
Use clear section markers such as intro, verse, chorus, bridge, and outro.
anti_patterns: Do not mix conflicting styles in one request.
Do not use copyrighted lyrics unless you have rights.
Do not paste API tokens or private credentials into music prompts.

faq.question: Does this skill generate full songs?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide ElevenLabs Music requests for vocal songs with sections and lyrics.

faq.question: Can it make instrumental music?
faq.answer: Yes. Use instrumental wording and the force_instrumental option for tracks without vocals.

faq.question: What tools are required?
faq.answer: You need the RunComfy CLI, a RunComfy account, and valid authentication.

faq.question: How long can the music be?
faq.answer: The documented range is 5 seconds to 5 minutes per generation request.

faq.question: Does it support sound effects?
faq.answer: No. This skill targets songs and tracks, not one-off sound effects.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
